preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p_i < i for i, p_i in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: The parent array p defines a valid tree structure with n-1 edges, where each city i (from 2 to n) is connected to a parent city p_i with index less than i.
The number of bus routes m is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in bus_routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route is a pair of distinct cities (a, b) within the valid city range.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query is a pair of distinct cities (v, u) within the valid city range.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per query.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['-1'] or (output_line.isdigit() and int(output_line) >= 1) for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' (no path) or a positive integer representing the minimum number of buses required.

postconditions.expression: all((v, u) in reachable_pairs and int(output_lines[i]) == min_buses[(v, u)] or (v, u) not in reachable_pairs and output_lines[i] == '-1' for i, (v, u) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (v, u), the output is '-1' if there is no path from v to u using bus routes, otherwise it is the minimum number of buses required to travel from v to u. The bus routes are defined by the shortest path between cities a and b in the tree, and you can travel between any stops on the route.
